summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc., a Canadian clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, attaching a press release reporting six-month interim TRAILHEAD data for SAT-3247 in Duchenne muscular dystrophy adults. The results show reduced muscle fat fraction (mean -3.7%), increased effort (+34% in TE99C), stable handgrip strength, lower CK (-38%), and a favorable safety profile. No transaction, M&A, restructuring, or corporate event is disclosed; this is a routine clinical-data update. The filing does not trigger a special-situations category. Management changes, deal terms, or strategic reviews are absent. The registrant is the issuer filing a standard ongoing disclosure.
